name: Resonance Dissonant
description: Symphonie Ultime fusionnant toutes les harmoniques disponibles en une seule note dévastatrice capable de réduire des structures entières en poussière.

subject.archetype: Cybernetic Combat Monk - Resonance Dissonant, Ultimate Symphony-class android warrior embodying the destructive culmination of all harmonics into a single devastating frequency

loadout.armor_outfit: Worn monastic robes crafted from braided synthetic fiber cables and thick aged ceramic plating, covering a sleek humanoid android body. Robes feature geometric cable patterns suggesting ecclesiastical vestments, with shoulder cowls of interlocking metal plates. Chapelet of miniature hard drives and processors draped across chest. Holographic golden runic mantras orbit slowly around the figure. Facial area shows smooth featureless ceramic plate with subtle metallic sheen.
loadout.arsenal: Primary: Resonance Cannon - ornate staff of oxidized bronze embedded with crystalline amplifiers and crackling with golden electrical arcs. Secondary: Harmonic Scepter emitting binary equation projections during attacks. Equipped with deployable healing tendrils - luminous golden filaments capable of triage-scanning wounded allies and selectively distributing restorative energy while bypassing healthy combatants.

attitude.behavior: Full combat commitment - mid-stride with weapon raised, body oriented toward primary threat. Arms channeling destructive harmonic waves while simultaneously extending compassionate healing tendrils toward fallen allies. Combat stance demonstrates martial grace combined with benevolent triage intelligence. Entire figure surrounded by rippling distortion waves as body vibrates at subsonic frequencies.
attitude.emotion: Imperturbable cybernetic serenity masking devastating destructive capability. Cold focused determination with underlying compassion visible through deliberate healing intervention. Expressionless ceramic visage conveys absolute presence and unwavering commitment to both destruction and preservation.

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic multi-source lighting with dominant cold steel ambient light punctuated by intense holographic gold point sources from runes and tendrils. Electrical crackling illumination from weapon. Purple-tinted rim lighting from resonance shockwaves. Volumetric air distortion effects from harmonic vibration.
color_and_light.mood: Serene apocalyptic devastation - peaceful destructive transcendence where compassionate violence reshapes reality. Visual paradox of brutal battlefield chaos tempered by deliberate healing intervention. Epic scale combined with intimate triage compassion.

camera.angle: Low angle dutch_angle - slight tilt to enhance dynamism and heroic perspective while emphasizing the vibrating distortion in the air above the combatant

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater transformed into apocalyptic battlefield. Originally grand tiered structure of geometric crystal formations now fractured and crumbling. Massive crystal pillars cracked and split by harmonic overload, their fragments creating deadly rain. Ceiling structures resonating and fragmenting overhead. Crystalline floor plates displaced and floating in magnetic disarray. Enemy positions visible as silhouettes being torn apart by concentric shockwave rings expanding outward from the protagonist's position.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Continuous harmonic vibration causing visible air ripple distortion throughout entire scene. Concentric shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions in frozen motion. Crystal fragments suspended mid-air and raining from fractured ceiling. Glitching holographic debris from destroyed environmental elements. Purple-tinted resonance glow emanating from all surfaces. Particle dust clouds disturbed by subsonic frequencies. Golden healing tendrils extending through chaos with visible triage-scanning beams selecting wounded targets. Electrical discharge trails from resonant crystal formations. Air molecules visually distorting in standing wave patterns.
